description: Angular component for configuring time series chart axis settings in a widget, including form controls, validation, and dynamic validator updates.

classes.name: TimeSeriesChartAxisSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing axis settings of a time series chart, including form controls, validation, and dynamic updates.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form controls and subscriptions for axis settings.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the form value changes.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches form controls with provided axis settings value.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Dynamically enables/disables form controls based on current form state.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.
